shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Modest hover and floating form depth

motion.name: chart-arrival

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Existing confirmed primary action; 44px minimum target.
components.css: .mp-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:10px 16px; border-radius:var(--radius-control); font-family:var(--font-sans); } .mp-button--primary { background:var(--color-accent); color:var(--color-accent-foreground); } .mp-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Visible Vietnamese label, neutral control edge and immediate focus.
components.html: <label class="mp-field">Họ và tên<input class="mp-input" placeholder="Nhập họ và tên" /></label>
components.css: .mp-field { display:grid; gap:8px; font-family:var(--font-sans); } .mp-input { min-height:44px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:var(--color-surface); color:var(--color-foreground); } .mp-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: Search and records carry the interface. Neutral surfaces stay quiet; cyan identifies the primary action and current selection.

rules.name: One action hue
rules.body: Cyan for brand and action; other hues encode genuine semantic states.

rules.name: Finite motion
rules.body: Transform and opacity only, with reduced-motion alternatives.

donts: No colored left stripes or decorative eyebrows
No nested cards or false controls
